outcome: Formula supplementation in the first week
cohort: 109 infants born early term by elective cesarean section and 109 infants born at term
finding: The study found that while early term infants may appear similar to term infants, they experience more short-term complications and may have lower neurodevelopmental scores at 18-24 months of age.
mod_finding: Infants born early term by elective cesarean section had a higher need for formula in the first week postpartum compared to term babies.
gest_age: Early term (37-38 weeks) and term (39-40 weeks)
